checks_run.procedure: Direct source review of the product change since round 16 and the full files it touches: sessionBound.ts, client.ts (identity recheck, asIdentityProbe, GET hold), queries.ts, App.tsx, session.tsx (navigation layout effect), the create/edit/detail pages, the admin pages, RecordForm/RowActions/ReasonDialog/useVersionedSave/LanguageSwitch, the P2 pages (refresh() checks) and eslint.config.js. Then grep for unguarded effects: raw setQueryData/navigate/<Navigate>/window.location, `await refresh()` without the check, the position of every begin()/beginSessionGuard()/useSessionNavigate call, other /me callers, and other effect channels (useMutation, postMessage, BroadcastChannel). Then a risky-pattern scan of the diff.
checks_run.command: git diff e3b2375..805da3e -- . ':!docs/delivery'; grep -rnE 'setQueryData|setQueriesData|\.navigate\(|<Navigate|window\.location' apps/web/src; grep -rn 'await refresh()' apps/web/src; grep -rn -B4 '= begin()' apps/web/src; bash aux-checks.sh (diff-scan)
checks_run.environment: Working tree at 23edabf (read-only review); Node 22.22.2 for aux-checks.sh in $TMPDIR/review-r17
checks_run.expected: Each effect of a user action is re-checked against the generation it began under; navigations hold page GETs behind /me; no weakening of sign-in/sign-out, CSRF, returnTo or the bilingual messages; no CDN, secrets or unsafe sinks introduced.
checks_run.actual:
The assignment's named range fe22d759..cbdb4f68 is the round-10->11 BE16 change, reviewed in rounds 11-16. The real since-round-16 range is e3b2375..805da3e: 30 files under apps/web plus eslint.config.js, with no apps/api, packages or worker change.
- All 10 begin() and 5 beginSessionGuard() sites capture the generation before their first await. useSessionNavigate is used only in two synchronous Cancel handlers. action.navigate/setQueryData re-check at call time.
- The raw useNavigate is left only in session.tsx, Shell.tsx and LoginPage.tsx (session transitions, justified disables). <Navigate> appears only in render paths (router index, session-end redirect, LoginPage signed-in redirect). safeReturnTo is unchanged.
- The 5 unchecked `await refresh()` calls are terminal: only setBusy(false) in finally follows, or a catch that has already set its error under the original generation.
- refreshEffectivePermissions goes through invalidateQueries(keys.me) -> fetchMe (sessionProbe). Its 5 s timeout path is covered by the createdBy check in TransformationDetailPage (probe Z1).
- endSession, noteSessionIdentity and markSignedOut all move the generation before the reset, so GETs held behind /me are refused if it moved.
- Writes neither wait for nor trigger the recheck, so they still carry the acting identity's CSRF token. The CSRF header code is unchanged.
- No new user-facing strings (no i18n diff).
- The diff scan hits only comments, setCsrfToken (moved into asIdentityProbe) and the LoginPage disable comment. No URL, CDN, eval, innerHTML or storage use was introduced.
- There is no useMutation, postMessage or BroadcastChannel in apps/web/src.
- Observation (not raised): the lint convention can be evaded by deliberate obfuscation (SEC-R17-19).

checks_run.procedure: New adversarial class probe Z1-Z6: any path where an effect of an action or request started under A lands under B after any number of awaits, plus the D-077 residual. A MutationObserver checks every DOM state, not only the final one.
checks_run.environment: $TMPDIR/r17p at 23edabf; Node 22.22.2 LANG unset and Node 24.21.0 LANG=C.UTF-8; resetSessionStateForTests in beforeEach
checks_run.expected: No DOM state shows B's header with A's data, or A's header with B's data, outside the documented 2 s residual. Same-identity controls still update and navigate.
checks_run.actual:
7/7 pass on both runtimes, exit 0, no error lines.
- Z1: the /me outlasts the 5 s permission-refresh timeout. The navigation runs under A's still-current generation, the detail GET is held behind /me, and B gets its own 404. 0 mixed states.
- Z2: an edit with a 3 s PATCH. The navigation-time /me is sent before any page GET. 0 mixed states. Z2c control passes.
- Z3: the residual is reproduced (a refetch within 2 s shows B's rows under A's header) and ends (the next GET after the window sends /me first; header B; A's rows gone).
- Z4: an immediate navigation sends /me first. 0 states with A's header over B's rows.
- Z5 (observation): a query-string-only navigation does not re-ask /me, which is within the documented residual.
- Z6 (observation): page GETs are held while /me is in flight.
DISCLOSURE: one dry run before the recorded runs failed Z2's original assertion (path stays /edit). The edit's awaits send no GET, so it navigates under A's still-current generation, which is not a stale effect. I replaced the assertion with the class invariant; probes/README.md records the history.
